321:   /** Used to create a [[ResultServiceProxy]].
322:     *
323:     * @param listeners
324:     *   A list of all known listeners.
325:     * @param simStartTime
326:     *   The start time of the simulation. This is used to convert the tick into
327:     *   a [[ZonedDateTime]].
328:     * @param bufferSize
329:     *   The size of the used message buffer. (Default: 10000)
330:     * @return
331:     *   A new behavior.
332:     */
333:   def apply(
334:       listeners: Seq[ActorRef[ResultResponse]],
335:       simStartTime: ZonedDateTime,
336:       bufferSize: Int = 10000,
337:   ): Behavior[Message] = Behaviors.withStash(bufferSize) { buffer =>
338:     idle(ResultServiceStateData(listeners, simStartTime))(using buffer)
339:   }

341:   /** The idle behavior of the [[ResultServiceProxy]].
342:     *
343:     * @param stateData
344:     *   The current state data.
345:     * @param buffer
346:     *   A buffer for messages.
347:     * @return
348:     *   A new behavior.
349:     */
350:   private def idle(
351:       stateData: ResultServiceStateData
352:   )(using
353:       buffer: StashBuffer[Message]
354:   ): Behavior[Message] = Behaviors
355:     .receivePartial[Message] {
356:       case (_, AddListener(listener)) =>
357:         idle(stateData.copy(listeners = stateData.listeners.appended(listener)))
358: 
359:       case (_, expectResult: ExpectResult) =>
360:         idle(stateData.waitForResult(expectResult))
361: 
362:       case (ctx, resultEvent: ResultEvent) =>
363:         // handles the event and updates the state data
364:         val updatedStateData =
365:           handleResultEvent(resultEvent, stateData)(using
366:             ctx.log,
367:             stateData.simStartTime,
368:           )
369: 
370:         // un-stash received requests
371:         buffer.unstashAll(idle(updatedStateData))
372: 
373:       case (_, NoResult(uuid, tick)) =>
374:         // un-stash received requests
375:         buffer.unstashAll(idle(stateData.stopWaitingForResult(uuid, tick)))
376: 
377:       case (_, requestResultMessage: RequestResult) =>
378:         val requestedResults = requestResultMessage.requestedResults
379:         val tick = requestResultMessage.tick
380: 
381:         if stateData.isWaiting(requestedResults, tick) then {
382: 
383:           buffer.stash(requestResultMessage)
384:           Behaviors.same
385:         } else {
386: 
387:           val results = stateData.getResults(
388:             requestedResults,
389:             requestResultMessage.thresholdTick,
390:           )
391: 
392:           requestResultMessage.replyTo ! ResultResponse(results)
393:           idle(stateData)
394:         }
395: 
396:       case (ctx, msg: DelayedStopHelper.StoppingMsg) =>
397:         DelayedStopHelper.handleMsg((ctx, msg))
398:     }
399:     .receiveSignal { case (ctx, PostStop) =>
400:       ctx.log.debug(
401:         "Shutdown initiated.\n\tThe following three winding results are not comprehensive and are not " +
402:           "handled in sinks:{}\n\tWaiting until writing result data is completed ...",
403:         stateData.threeWindingResults.keys
404:           .map { case Transformer3wKey(model, zdt) =>
405:             s"model '$model' at $zdt"
406:           }
407:           .mkString("\n\t\t"),
408:       )
409: 
410:       Behaviors.same
411:     }

413:   /** Method for handling and updating the state data after a result event was
414:     * received.
415:     *
416:     * @param resultEvent
417:     *   The event to process.
418:     * @param stateData
419:     *   The current state data.
420:     * @param log
421:     *   A logger for logging.
422:     * @return
423:     *   The updated state data.
424:     */
425:   private def handleResultEvent(
426:       resultEvent: ResultEvent,
427:       stateData: ResultServiceStateData,
428:   )(using log: Logger, startTime: ZonedDateTime): ResultServiceStateData =
429:     resultEvent match {
430:       case PowerFlowResultEvent(
431:             nodeResults,
432:             switchResults,
433:             lineResults,
434:             transformer2wResults,
435:             partialTransformer3wResults,
436:             congestionResults,
437:           ) =>
438:         // handling of three winding transformers
439:         val (updatedThreeWindingResults, transformer3wResults) =
440:           handleThreeWindingTransformers(
441:             partialTransformer3wResults,
442:             stateData.threeWindingResults,
443:           )
444: 
445:         val oldResults = stateData.mainResult
446: 
447:         val (newPrimary, receivedResult) =
448:           (transformer3wResults ++ nodeResults ++ switchResults ++ lineResults ++ transformer2wResults)
449:             .foldLeft(Map.empty[UUID, ResultEntity], Seq.empty[UUID]) {
450:               case ((allChangedResults, allKeys), result) =>
451:                 val uuid = result.getInputModel
452: 
453:                 val updatedResMap = oldResults.get(uuid) match {
454:                   case Some(oldResult) if isUnchanged(result, oldResult) =>
455:                     allChangedResults
456:                   case _ =>
457:                     allChangedResults.updated(uuid, result)
458:                 }
459: 
460:                 (updatedResMap, allKeys :+ uuid)
461:             }
462: 
463:         val oldAdditionalResults = stateData.additionalResults
464: 
465:         val newAdditional = congestionResults.flatMap { res =>
466:           val uuid = res.getInputModel
467: 
468:           if newPrimary.contains(uuid) then {
469:             oldAdditionalResults.get(uuid) match {
470:               case Some(oldResult) if isUnchanged(res, oldResult) =>
471:                 None
472:               case _ =>
473:                 Some(uuid -> res)
474:             }
475: 
476:           } else None
477:         }.toMap
478: 
479:         val allChangedResults =
480:           collectResults(newPrimary.keys, newPrimary, newAdditional)
481: 
482:         // notify listener
483:         stateData.notifyListener(allChangedResults)
484: 
485:         val changedKeys = allChangedResults.keys
486:         val tick =
487:           newPrimary.values.find(_ => true).map(_.getTime.toTick).getOrElse(-1L)
488: 
489:         val lastUpdatedTicks = newPrimary.keys.map(k => k -> tick).toMap
490: 
491:         stateData.copy(
492:           mainResult = oldResults ++ newPrimary,
493:           threeWindingResults = updatedThreeWindingResults,
494:           additionalResults = stateData.additionalResults.removedAll(
495:             changedKeys
496:           ) ++ newAdditional,
497:           waitingForResults =
498:             stateData.waitingForResults.removedAll(receivedResult),
499:           lastUpdate = stateData.lastUpdate ++ lastUpdatedTicks,
500:         )
501: 
502:       case ParticipantResultEvent(systemParticipantResult) =>
503:         // notify listener
504:         stateData.notifyListener(systemParticipantResult)
505: 
506:         stateData.addResult(systemParticipantResult)
507: 
508:       case ThermalResultEvent(thermalResult) =>
509:         // notify listener
510:         stateData.notifyListener(thermalResult)
